paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
notes: Ferromagnetic axion haloscope (QUAX prototype) constraining the axion-electron coupling g_aee. Reported limit g_aee < 4.9e-10 at 95% C.L. for m_a = 58 ueV (58.5 ueV ~ 14 GHz). The exclusion spans a ~3 MHz scan range around 14 GHz; only the central best value is quoted in text. DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3.
